info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 從策略性的觀點，研討行銷管理的程序，包括分析行銷環境、策略性行銷決策、戰術性行銷決策，以及執行與控制等，期使能結合理論與實務，提昇行銷管理素養，並培養分析判斷之能力。
description.describe_eh: To understand the overall concepts and theory of marketing management from strategic point of view.  To discuss the marketing management process, including marketing environment analyzing, strategic marketing decision making, static marketing decision making, implementing and controlling.  To apply the marketing management theory to the practical cases.
description.pre_subname: ECON1001經濟學(一)、ECON1002經濟學(二)、MKT1019行銷管理、MGT1002企業概論
description.pre_sub_ename: ECON1001 ECONOMICS(1)、ECON1002 ECONOMICS(2)、MKT1019 MARKETING MANAGEMENT、MGT1002 INTRODUCTION TO BUSINESS

targets.describe_ch: 理解在理論與實務及案例中之行銷問題
targets.describe_en: To understand problems of marketing through theory and practical case.

targets.describe_ch: 分析在企業經營中，行銷與其投資組合之相互配合，追求企業之最大利潤
targets.describe_en: In business operation, to analysis the match of marketing and investment in order to pursue the biggest profit of business.

readings.tpc_book_en: Selected Chapters of the books above, additional readings provided in class or through iLearn.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students must attend class in either Week 1 or Week 2 to participate in essential course arrangements, including group formation, scheduling, and course management. Failure to do so will result in being unable to complete the course.

Additionally:
1. Punctuality matters. Arriving late or leaving early may result in being marked absent.
2. Use respectful language. Inappropriate language will lead to immediate dismissal from the class.
3. Respect and integrity. Treat all classmates and instructors with respect. Discrimination, harassment, or dishonesty will be addressed according to university policies.
4. Collaborate and support peers. Group work is encouraged, and helping others can enhance everyone’s learning experience.
5. Take responsibility for missed work. If you miss a class, it’s your responsibility to catch up on the material.
6. Collaborative Effort in Group Work: All members of a group are expected to contribute equally to the final project. Ensure clear communication, share responsibilities, and support one another. If any group member consistently fails to contribute, the issue should be reported to the instructor immediately, and individual grades may be adjusted accordingly
7. Use of AI Tools: ChatGPT and other AI tools may be used as supplementary resources. However, assignments must reflect the student's own understanding and effort. If a student cannot explain or elaborate on the content of their work, the assignment will receive a zero score.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: I hope that all students can complete various learning tasks according to the teaching progress, participate actively in all learning activities, and submit assignments on time. Completing these tasks will help you meet the learning objectives of this course and achieve the grades you deserve. If you encounter any difficulties during the semester, please don't hesitate to make use of my office hours, or schedule a separate appointment so we can work together to find solutions. Students are further required to check their university email regularly as all notifications will be sent by iLearn to this address.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Learning should be grounded in integrity. Any student who submits work that is not their own will be considered dishonest. Cheating or plagiarism in assignments or reports will result in a score of zero. You are allowed to quote or reference the words or ideas of others from publications, websites, or other sources, as long as you properly cite them. Originality is essential; any plagiarized work will receive a "0" or a "fail" grade. Repeat offenses will be handled according to the student conduct policies of Feng Chia University.
